FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.CachedNote: Showing cached data. The marketplace did not answer as expected just now.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.StatusInactiveHint: Installed, but not activated in Matomo yet.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ReportBugFileWrongType: %s is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ReportBugTooMany: A report can hold up to 3 screenshots.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ReportBugAttachFailed: Report sent, but %s could not be attached.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ReportBugRequired: Please fill in title and description.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.AuthErrorNote: The marketplace rejects the instance token. Please check it in the plugin settings. Showing cached data.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DevCheckoutHint: Installed as a git checkout or symlink. Update it with git, not here.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SwitchingHint: After the Matomo update the connector installs the version of this plugin for the running Matomo by itself. Use "Switch now" in the notice to start it right away.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DevCheckoutRefused: %s is installed as a git checkout or symlink and was not changed. Update it with git.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.InstallFailed: %1$s could not be installed or updated: %2$s
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.InstallRefused: %1$s could not be installed or updated: the marketplace refused the download for this Matomo instance. Check in your account on plugins.feinwerk.io that this instance has a valid license for it and that the instance token in the plugin settings is current, then try again.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SelfUpdateAvailable: A new version of the Feinwerk Plugins connector is available: %1$s → %2$s.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbHeldNotice: Not updated automatically because the update changes the database: %s. Please install it yourself. Matomo then asks to run the database update.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbHeldHint: This update changes the database, so it is never installed automatically. Install it yourself; Matomo then runs the database update.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SwapPendingNotice: Matomo was updated to version %1$s. The connector is switching your Feinwerk plugins to their builds for this Matomo version.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SwapWaiting: Not available for Matomo %1$s yet: %2$s. The connector keeps checking and switches them as soon as they are released.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ReadinessNotice: Ready for Matomo %1$s? %2$s of %3$s of your Feinwerk plugins are already available for Matomo %1$s.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ReadinessBeta: Available as a beta so far: %1$s.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ReadinessMissing: Not available yet: %1$s. If you rely on them, hold off on the Matomo update until they are available.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ReadinessAllReady: All your Feinwerk plugins are ready for Matomo %1$s. After the Matomo update the connector switches them automatically.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ReadinessBackup: Before you update, make a full backup of the Matomo files and the database: it is the only way back to Matomo %1$s.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SwapResultSwitched: Switched to the builds for Matomo %1$s: %2$s.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SwapResultInactive: Updated but not activated, because it is not known whether they were active before the Matomo update: %1$s. Activate them under Administration → Plugins → Manage Plugins if you use them.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SwapResultKeptOff: Updated and left switched off, as before the Matomo update: %1$s.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SwapResultErrors: Could not be switched: %1$s. The connector tries again later.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SwapResultNeedsAdmin: Could not be switched automatically after several attempts: %1$s. Please update or activate them on the Feinwerk Plugins screen (Administration → Feinwerk Plugins → Manage).
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SwapResultNeedsLicense: No valid license on this Matomo instance, so not switched: %1$s. Renew the license in your account on plugins.feinwerk.io or assign it to this instance, then update them on the Feinwerk Plugins screen (Administration → Feinwerk Plugins → Manage).
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SwapResultDbUpdate: If Matomo asks for a database update, run it to finish the switch.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConnectTitle: Connect this Matomo with your Feinwerk account
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConnectIntro: Sign in at plugins.feinwerk.io, choose the instance for this Matomo and you are back here. The licenses of that instance apply right away.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.WelcomeNotice: Feinwerk Connector is active. Connect this Matomo with your Feinwerk account to install and update the Feinwerk plugins here. No account yet? You can also look at the plugins without one.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.BrowseFailed: The list of Feinwerk plugins could not be loaded. Please try again later.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.BrowseHint: Loads the public list of Feinwerk plugins from plugins.feinwerk.io. No account is needed, and no data about your websites or users is sent.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.BrowseIntro: The Feinwerk plugins (list of %s). Connect this Matomo to install them.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.NotAvailableHere: Not yet available for your Matomo version
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConnectManual: Your browser cannot reach plugins.feinwerk.io? Enter the instance token from your account in the plugin settings.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConnectDone: Connected with the instance "%s" of your Feinwerk account.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConnectCancelled: The connection was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConnectExpired: This connection request has expired or does not belong to this Matomo. Please start it again.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeBadgeHint: This install changes the database. Click to see what changes.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeColumns: Matomo adds columns to its visit data tables: %s.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeDuration: Depending on the size of the database this takes from seconds to hours. Back up the database first.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeLarge: This Matomo instance is large (about %s visits). Here the database update easily fails in the browser, for example with "Bad Gateway". Run it on the command line instead:
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeLargeUnknown: This Matomo instance counts as large. Here the database update easily fails in the browser, for example with "Bad Gateway". Run it on the command line instead:
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeStepConsole: If Matomo then shows its database update page, do not start the update there. Run this on the server:
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeStepInstallOnly: The connector installs the plugin but does not activate it, so the table change does not run in the browser.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeStepActivate: Then activate it on the server:
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeAckConsole: I will run the database update on the command line, not in the browser.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeAckActivate: I will activate the plugin on the command line.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeCliHint: With a very large database, run the database update on the command line instead:
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbUpdateConsole: %1$s is installed. Matomo still needs a database update. Run it on the server, not in the browser: %2$s
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbUpdateBrowser: %1$s is installed. Matomo still needs a database update; its page opens on the next click. With a large database run it on the server instead: %2$s
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ActivateOnConsole: %1$s is installed but not activated yet. Activate it on the server: %2$s
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeOptConsoleActivate: Only install it; I will activate the plugin on the command line (recommended for a very large database).
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.DbChangeTitleMigration: This update needs a database update
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ClaimDone: The license for %1$s now covers this Matomo. You can install the plugin.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ClaimAlreadyLicensed: This Matomo already has a license for %1$s.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ClaimCoveredAsTest: This Matomo is a test instance: %1$s is covered by the license of your account.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ClaimNoFreeSeat: All licenses for %1$s are in use. Free one in your customer account or buy another license.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ClaimNoLicense: Your account has no active license for %1$s.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.LicensingUnavailable: The Feinwerk store does not offer this yet. Assign the license in your customer account on plugins.feinwerk.io.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.Offline: This server cannot reach the Feinwerk store right now. Please try again later.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.BuyNoAccount: This Matomo is not connected with a customer account. Connect it with your Feinwerk account first.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.BuyReturnReady: The license for %1$s is active. You can install the plugin now.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.BuyReturnPending: The license for %1$s has not arrived yet. Click Refresh in a minute.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ClaimLicenseHint: Your account has a license for this plugin that is not in use yet.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.BuyLicenseHint: Buy in the Feinwerk store with the account this Matomo is connected to. Afterwards you come back here.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.OfflineNote: This server cannot reach the Feinwerk store. Without internet access, download the plugins as ZIP files in your customer account and upload them in Matomo.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConsoleUpdateTitle: Run the database update on the server
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConsoleUpdateIntro: This Matomo instance is large. In the browser the database update easily fails here, for example with "Bad Gateway", while the database keeps working. So the Feinwerk Marketplace Connector does not start it in the browser. Run it on the server:
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConsoleUpdateThen: When the command has finished, click "Check again".
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConsoleUpdateOverride: Without access to the command line you can switch this off: add %s to config/config.ini.php. The database update then runs in the browser again, with the risk that it fails.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SettingTokenHelp: The instance token of this Matomo from your customer account at plugins.feinwerk.io (My instances, Show token). The button "Connect with Feinwerk account" on the Feinwerk Plugins screen enters it for you.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SettingAutoApplyHelp: The daily check installs updates automatically for the plugins selected here. Updates that change the database are held back and shown instead. The connector itself and plugins installed as a git checkout or symlink are never updated automatically.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SettingAutoApplySelf: The connector cannot update itself automatically. Update it on the Feinwerk Plugins screen.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SettingInfoNoticesHelp: Notices that only inform, for example which Feinwerk plugins already exist for the next Matomo version (with the reminder to back up before that update) and which plugin updates are available. Available updates still show in the menu and on the Manage tab. Warnings and everything you need to act on always show.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConsoleUpdateAnywayHint: You can also run the update once here in the browser. On a large database it can take longer than the web server allows. If the page then ends with an error such as "Bad Gateway", the update usually keeps running in the database: do not start it again, wait a few minutes and click "Check again".
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConsoleUpdateAnywayConfirm: I want to run the update in the browser anyway.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.FeedbackQuestion_discover: Did you find what you were looking for on this page?
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.FeedbackQuestion_manage: Do installing and updating work as expected here?
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.FeedbackThanksDown: Thank you. If you like, describe the problem to our support.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SupportTitle: Opens the Feinwerk contact form in a new tab
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.ConsoleUpdateAnywayBusy: An update started in the browser is probably still running, so no second one was started. Wait a few minutes and click "Check again".
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.NoResults: No plugin matches the search and filters.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.FeedbackQuestion_licenses: Do you find everything about your licenses here?
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.TasksEmpty: Nothing to do: every Feinwerk plugin is up to date and licensed.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.Task_connection_auth: The Feinwerk store rejects the instance token of this Matomo.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.Task_connection_offline: This Matomo server cannot reach the Feinwerk store.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.Task_db_update: A database update is still pending for %s. Run it on the server:
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.Task_switch_pending: Matomo was updated to a new major version; some Feinwerk plugins are not switched yet.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.Task_license_missing: %s has no valid license for this Matomo instance.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.Task_db_held: The update of %1$s to %2$s changes the database and was therefore not installed automatically.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.Task_license_claimable: You have a license for %s that no Matomo instance uses yet.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.LicensesIntro: Which paid Feinwerk plugins are licensed for this Matomo instance. You manage subscriptions, invoices and payment details in your customer account.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.LicensesEmpty: The Feinwerk store lists no paid plugins.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.BatchExpired: The security check has expired. Please reload the page and start again.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.BatchInvalid: This plugin cannot be updated this way.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.BatchDbIntro: These updates change the database. Once one of them is installed, Matomo asks for its database update; update the others after it:
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.BatchHeld: Still to update after the database update: %s.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SettingRecommendationsHelp: Shows a Feinwerk plugin that this Matomo does not have yet on the Administration home page and on the Discover tab. Nothing is sent for it, and you can close each recommendation.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SettingRecommendationsConfigOff: Currently switched off by promotions = 0 in the section [FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector] of config.ini.php, whatever this setting says.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SettingPromotions: Show notes on other Feinwerk offers
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SettingPromotionsHelp: Feinwerk plugins may show administrators a short note on other Feinwerk offers. Nothing is loaded from outside for it. When this is off, no other Feinwerk plugin shows such notes.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.SettingPromotionsConfigOff: Currently switched off for all Feinwerk plugins by promotions = 0 in the section [FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector] of config.ini.php, whatever this setting says.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.PromoOffUndo: Switch them on again under General settings
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.StateChanged: Something changed since this page was loaded, for example an update.
FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector.BatchNoAnswer: No answer for %s. Please check on Manage whether the update arrived.
